Element: NONE: non-elemental physical/mana phenomenon; do not invent fire/lightning/holy magic. Limits: 시야·사거리·자세와 실제 지형에 제한되며 자동 적중·절대 방어가 아니다..
Regional context: 벨로아, 농경·기병·기사 문화; terrain . Background is an understated appropriate medieval fantasy environment supporting action, no extra named locations invented.
LOW restrained tier: a single narrow concentrated effect at hand/weapon/contact point. No full body aura, no enormous beams, no elemental storm. Proficient yet contained.
Camera: eye-level three-quarter left view, subject on right. Dynamic weight shift matching technique, visible hands properly connected to weapon/tool; defense/support stays defense/support, never converted into destruction. Keep face prominent and readable for an eventual face crop (face width roughly 16-22% of entire canvas). Focused, character-appropriate emotion, not automatic smile. Not front-facing standing portrait.
Style: polished 2D anime/cartoon fantasy in SAME visual quality as references, clean linework, rich readable game colors and painterly cinematic lighting. Background and effects fully painted as OPAQUE image. Wide horizontal 16:9 PNG ideally 1920x1080 or larger. Safe edges for face and key weapon/gesture. No text, lettering, numbers, logos, UI, frames, watermark or split panels. ONE character only. Absolutely no opponent, no other character, no foreground enemy hands, enemy body, silhouette or figure. Show the solo knight bracing with his sword; sparks come from the weapon itself, not a drawn opponent.
